# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py from neurawall/core/config.py. Do not edit. -->

Configuration is layered: **defaults → YAML file → environment → runtime overrides**. Every value is validated at startup and unknown keys are rejected.

- **YAML file:** set `NEURAWALL_CONFIG=/etc/neurawall/server.yaml`; keys mirror the names below (nested sections as mappings).
- **Environment:** `NEURAWALL_` prefix, `__` between section and key (e.g. `NEURAWALL_LLM__MODEL`).
- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is also honoured when `llm.api_key` is unset.

## Server

| Key | Environment | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `NEURAWALL_ENVIRONMENT` | `development` / `production` / `test` | `development` | `production` enforces a configured secret key and marks the console accordingly. |
| `data_dir` | `NEURAWALL_DATA_DIR` | Path | `data` | Holds the SQLite database (if used), bundle-signing key and bootstrap secret. Mode 0700. |
| `database_url` | `NEURAWALL_DATABASE_URL` | str \| None | — | SQLAlchemy URL, e.g. `postgresql+psycopg://user:pass@host/neurawall`. Empty = SQLite in data_dir. |
| `host` | `NEURAWALL_HOST` | str | `0.0.0.0` | Listen address. |
| `port` | `NEURAWALL_PORT` | int | `8080` | Listen port. |
| `public_url` | `NEURAWALL_PUBLIC_URL` | str | `http://localhost:8080` | Externally reachable URL (shown in enrollment instructions; `https://` enables HSTS). |
| `cors_origins` | `NEURAWALL_CORS_ORIGINS` | list[str] | `[]` | Allowed browser origins if the console is served from another origin (normally empty). |
| `log_level` | `NEURAWALL_LOG_LEVEL` | `DEBUG` / `INFO` / `WARNING` / `ERROR` | `INFO` | Log verbosity. |
| `log_json` | `NEURAWALL_LOG_JSON` | bool | `True` | Structured JSON logs (recommended in production) instead of human-readable text. |
| `demo_mode` | `NEURAWALL_DEMO_MODE` | bool | `False` | Generate synthetic traffic from a built-in demo sensor (for evaluation / sales demos). |
| `flow_retention_seconds` | `NEURAWALL_FLOW_RETENTION_SECONDS` | int \| None | — | Override flow retention. Unset = the active plan's retention (7/30/90 days). |

## `inference`

| Key | Environment | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inference.t2_escalation_threshold` | `NEURAWALL_INFERENCE__T2_ESCALATION_THRESHOLD` | float | `0.6` | Tier 1 score at which a flow is escalated to Tier 2 (blueprint §5.4). |
| `inference.t3_ambiguous_low` | `NEURAWALL_INFERENCE__T3_AMBIGUOUS_LOW` | float | `0.4` | Tier 2 confidence band considered ambiguous -> escalate to Tier 3. |
| `inference.t3_ambiguous_high` | `NEURAWALL_INFERENCE__T3_AMBIGUOUS_HIGH` | float | `0.7` | Upper bound of the ambiguous band (above it, Tier 2 is confident enough on its own). |
| `inference.t2_rate_per_second` | `NEURAWALL_INFERENCE__T2_RATE_PER_SECOND` | float | `500.0` | Max Tier 2 invocations per node per second. |
| `inference.baseline_warmup_flows` | `NEURAWALL_INFERENCE__BASELINE_WARMUP_FLOWS` | int | `200` | Baseline warm-up (flows per entity) before Tier 1 scores are trusted. |
| `inference.isolation_forest_trees` | `NEURAWALL_INFERENCE__ISOLATION_FOREST_TREES` | int | `100` | Isolation Forest size (accuracy vs CPU). |

## `llm`

| Key | Environment | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `llm.provider` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__PROVIDER` | `anthropic` / `offline` | `anthropic` | `offline` always uses the deterministic heuristic advisor (no data leaves the host). |
| `llm.model` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__MODEL` | str | `claude-opus-5` | Claude model used for triage, rule drafting and narration. |
| `llm.api_key` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__API_KEY` | SecretStr \| None | — | Anthropic API key; falls back to `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Without one, Tier 3 runs offline. |
| `llm.max_tokens` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__MAX_TOKENS` | int | `16000` | Output token ceiling per Tier 3 call. |
| `llm.effort` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__EFFORT` | `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` | `high` | Reasoning effort for Tier 3 calls (cost vs thoroughness). |
| `llm.server_side_fallbacks` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__SERVER_SIDE_FALLBACKS` | bool | `True` | Server-side refusal fallbacks (beta ``server-side-fallback-2026-07-01``). |
| `llm.workspace_id` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__WORKSPACE_ID` | str \| None | — | Anthropic workspace id, required when the API key is not scoped to a workspace (sent as the `anthropic-workspace-id` header). Falls back to `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID`. |
| `llm.max_calls_per_hour` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__MAX_CALLS_PER_HOUR` | int | `120` | Hard budget on Tier 3 invocations per hour, per cluster (blueprint §5.4). |
| `llm.timeout_seconds` | `NEURAWALL_LLM__TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | float | `60.0` | Per-request timeout for Tier 3 calls; on timeout the heuristic advisor answers. |

## `policy`

| Key | Environment | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `policy.blast_radius_threshold` | `NEURAWALL_POLICY__BLAST_RADIUS_THRESHOLD` | float | `0.01` | Drafts affecting more than this fraction of historical traffic are flagged. |
| `policy.simulation_window_seconds` | `NEURAWALL_POLICY__SIMULATION_WINDOW_SECONDS` | int | `604800` | Replay window (seconds) used for rule simulation. |
| `policy.bundle_ttl_warning_seconds` | `NEURAWALL_POLICY__BUNDLE_TTL_WARNING_SECONDS` | int | `86400` | Nodes warn when running a bundle older than this (blueprint §3.3). |
| `policy.require_four_eyes` | `NEURAWALL_POLICY__REQUIRE_FOUR_EYES` | bool | `False` | Four-eyes: the approver of a rule change must differ from its author. |
| `policy.rollout_stage_seconds` | `NEURAWALL_POLICY__ROLLOUT_STAGE_SECONDS` | int | `300` | Minimum dwell time per canary stage before auto-advance (5% -> 25% -> 100%). |
| `policy.rollback_block_rate_increase` | `NEURAWALL_POLICY__ROLLBACK_BLOCK_RATE_INCREASE` | float | `0.02` | Auto-rollback if canary nodes block this much more traffic than the rest. |
| `policy.starter_rules` | `NEURAWALL_POLICY__STARTER_RULES` | bool | `True` | Seed a starter rule pack on first boot. |

## `auth`

| Key | Environment | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.secret_key` | `NEURAWALL_AUTH__SECRET_KEY` | SecretStr \| None | — | HMAC key for console sessions. Required in production (`openssl rand -base64 48`). |
| `auth.access_token_ttl_seconds` | `NEURAWALL_AUTH__ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS` | int | `28800` | Console session lifetime. |
| `auth.bootstrap_admin_email` | `NEURAWALL_AUTH__BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL` | str | `admin@neurawall.local` | Email of the admin account created on first start. |
| `auth.bootstrap_admin_password` | `NEURAWALL_AUTH__BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | SecretStr \| None | — | Initial admin password. If unset, one is generated into `data_dir/initial-admin-password.txt`. |
| `auth.login_rate_per_minute` | `NEURAWALL_AUTH__LOGIN_RATE_PER_MINUTE` | int | `10` | Login attempts allowed per minute per client IP and per account. |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `billing.plan` | `NEURAWALL_BILLING__PLAN` | `community` / `pro` / `business` / `enterprise` / `enterprise_dedicated` | `community` | Plan for installs not billed through Stripe (self-hosted licences, Enterprise Dedicated). An active Stripe subscription takes precedence. |

| `billing.stripe_portal_configuration_id` | `NEURAWALL_BILLING__STRIPE_PORTAL_CONFIGURATION_ID` | str \| None | — | Stripe Customer Portal configuration id (optional; Stripe default otherwise). |
| `billing.price_pro_month` | `NEURAWALL_BILLING__PRICE_PRO_MONTH` | str \| None | — | Stripe Price ids per plan and interval. |
| `billing.price_pro_year` | `NEURAWALL_BILLING__PRICE_PRO_YEAR` | str \| None | — |  |
| `billing.price_business_month` | `NEURAWALL_BILLING__PRICE_BUSINESS_MONTH` | str \| None | — |  |
| `billing.price_business_year` | `NEURAWALL_BILLING__PRICE_BUSINESS_YEAR` | str \| None | — |  |
| `billing.price_enterprise_month` | `NEURAWALL_BILLING__PRICE_ENTERPRISE_MONTH` | str \| None | — |  |

## Production requirements

- `environment: production` refuses to start without `auth.secret_key`.
- Use PostgreSQL (`database_url: postgresql+psycopg://…`) for production; SQLite is for single-host trials.
- The data directory holds the bundle-signing key: back it up and restrict access.
